description: Pinned metadata for upstream STC development assets and the open Arduino compiler toolchain. Binary files are not vendored in this repository.

vendorAssets.name: AiCube-ISP
vendorAssets.notes: Official configuration, ISP programming, remote-upgrade and debug utility. It is not a C compiler.

vendorAssets.name: STC8G/STC8H library and demo code
vendorAssets.versionSource: latest date in the archive UPDATE-NOTE
vendorAssets.notes: Keil-oriented source, prebuilt libraries and examples.

vendorAssets.name: STC32G software library
vendorAssets.versionSource: latest date in the archive UPDATE-NOTE
vendorAssets.notes: Keil C251-oriented source, prebuilt libraries and examples. Do not assume that its source or libraries are compatible with STC32CL.

vendorAssets.name: AI8051U traditional-style software library
vendorAssets.versionSource: latest date in the archive UPDATE-NOTE
vendorAssets.notes: Traditional-style Keil C51/C251-oriented source, prebuilt libraries and examples.

vendorAssets.name: AI8051U innovative-style 32-bit library and demos
vendorAssets.versionSource: latest entry in the archive library update record and date on the official STC library page
vendorAssets.notes: Innovative-style 32-bit reference source and examples for the vendor C251 workflow; not linked into the Arduino core.

vendorAssets.name: AI8051U innovative-style 8-bit library and demos
vendorAssets.versionSource: latest entry in the archive library update record and date on the official STC library page
vendorAssets.notes: Innovative-style 8-bit reference source and examples for the vendor C51 workflow; not linked into the Arduino core.

vendorAssets.name: STC USB CDC/HID library and demos
vendorAssets.versionSource: date published on the official STC library page and latest archive entries
vendorAssets.notes: Current USB CDC/HID headers, prebuilt Keil/IAR/SDCC libraries and demos. It is a reference asset only and is not linked into the Arduino core.

compilerToolchains.name: SDCC MCS-251 fork
compilerToolchains.notes: Community fork, not an official STC compiler release. The MCS51 backend is the stable path; the MCS251 backend remains experimental.

redistribution.reason: The redistribution terms for STC SDK archives and their proprietary prebuilt .LIB files were not clear enough to justify copying them into this repository.
redistribution.downloadPolicy: Opt-in only. Download from the recorded upstream URL and verify both exact byte length and SHA-256.
